objectives.title: Launch
objectives.hint: Pick a rocket in the assembly building, press Launch, then Space to ignite.

objectives.title: Reach space ({space} km)
objectives.hint: Fly up and east, then stage when the engines burn out.

objectives.title: Achieve a stable orbit of {home}
objectives.hint: Circularise at apoapsis with a maneuver node.

objectives.title: Reach orbit of {moon}
objectives.hint: Target {moon} in the map, plan a transfer, and burn retrograde at periapsis to be captured.
